competitors.name: Frozen food category
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Circana/210 Analytics data showing total food and beverage unit sales fell 0.9% in the four weeks ending July 26, while frozen foods posted a 0.2% unit increase, the department's first gain in several months. Frozen snacks rose 3.2%, frozen baked goods rose 3.7%, and frozen meals declined 2.1%.

competitors.name: Giant Food / Ahold Delhaize USA
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Giant Food launched in-store Savings Stations across all 162 stores. Shoppers can scan a loyalty card or enter a phone number to load weekly digital coupons and personalized offers, print customized savings lists, and enroll in the loyalty program.

competitors.name: Conversational grocery AI / Cooklist
competitors.action: Grocery Dive published a Cooklist viewpoint arguing that conversational AI is shifting grocery discovery from keyword search to shopper-declared intent before purchase. The piece says grocers need machine-readable product metadata including ingredients, allergens, prep time, dietary fit, nutritional category, serving yields and recipe use cases to support AI-built baskets.

trends.topic: Frozen pockets of growth inside a weaker grocery basket
trends.magnitude: Frozen foods +0.2% units while total food and beverage units fell 0.9% in the four weeks ending July 26
trends.context: The freezer aisle is holding up better than much of the store, but frozen meals remain pressured. Real Dough should treat frozen strength as category support while watching meal-price sensitivity and snack/baked-good momentum.

trends.topic: Retailers making digital discounts more accessible in-store
trends.magnitude: Giant Food rolled Savings Stations to all 162 stores
trends.context: Digital coupons are becoming an in-store value tool, not just an app feature. Premium frozen brands should expect more promotion visibility through loyalty platforms and buyer pressure for offers that shoppers can easily activate.

trends.topic: AI grocery interfaces raising the bar for product data quality
trends.magnitude: Cooklist argues conversational shopping requires metadata beyond brand, price and category
trends.context: Products that can be matched to occasions, dietary constraints and recipes are more likely to surface in AI-assisted baskets. Real Dough should keep retailer data fields complete for sourdough, clean-label, prep, ingredient and meal-use attributes.
